description: In-app UX for the share link: BuddyLinkController state (activeShare restored from prefs) and the createShareLink / revokeShareLink fire-and-forget actions + a shareUrl helper; the EN + Greek AppStrings for all new copy; and the 'Share live location' Compose card in BuddyLinkSection (create pill + optional label, active URL + remaining-time + Copy/Share pills + destructive Stop control), using JogginTheme.colors tokens only and reusing the existing Clipboard + ACTION_SEND share-sheet pattern. Depends on FEAT-001 (ShareLink type, ShareLinkValidity/ShareLifetime, repository methods, BuddyConstants). Must not regress the existing Buddy Link / Cheer / tap-to-locate UI or the 4-theme system.
steps: In app/src/main/java/com/example/joggingapp/BuddyLinkController.kt add observable state: var activeShare by mutableStateOf<ShareLink?>(...); private set, reconstructed on init from PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_TOKEN + PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_EXPIRES_AT (null when the token is absent OR System.currentTimeMillis() >= expiresAt). Add fun createShareLink(label: String?, onResult: (BuddyResult<ShareLink>) -> Unit): if a still-valid activeShare already exists, return it via onResult WITHOUT minting a second (one-active-share UX invariant); otherwise scope.launch { val r = repo.createShareLink(label?.trim()?.take(40)); if (r is Success) { activeShare = r.value; applySharingState() }; onResult(r) } — applySharingState() starts BuddyLocationService if CONDITION-1 holds, reusing the existing permission / 'Allow all the time' path (no new permission flow). Add fun revokeShareLink(onResult: (BuddyResult<Unit>) -> Unit): val t = activeShare?.token ?: return; scope.launch { val r = repo.revokeShareLink(t); if (r is Success) activeShare = null; onResult(r) } — clear activeShare ONLY on success (a failed revoke must not claim it stopped). Add fun shareUrl(token: String): String = "https://" + BuddyConstants.INVITE_HTTPS_HOST + "/" + BuddyConstants.SHARE_PATH_PREFIX + "?t=" + token.

In app/src/main/java/com/example/joggingapp/Strings.kt add new properties to the AppStrings class with defaults (var ... = "" for plain, var ... = { _ -> "" } for function-typed) and set EVERY one in BOTH buildEnglishStrings() and buildGreekStrings(): shareLiveTitle (card title), shareLiveCreate (create pill label), shareLiveLabelHint (optional-label field hint), shareLiveRemaining: (String) -> String ("Live for {remaining}"), shareLiveStop (stop control), shareLiveCopy, shareLiveShareSubject, shareLiveShareBody: (String) -> String (interpolates the URL), shareLinkCreated, shareLinkCopied, shareLinkStopped, shareLinkCreateFailed, shareLinkStopFailed. Use natural EN wording and formal monotonic Greek matching the existing buddyCheer*/buddyCode* tone. Reuse the existing buddyUnavailableBackend for the backend-unavailable note (do not add a new one).

In app/src/main/java/com/example/joggingapp/BuddyLinkSection.kt add a 'Share live location' card BELOW the existing Buddy-code card, gated by controller.enabled like the rest of the section. Reuse the exact pill chrome in the file (Modifier.clip(CircleShape).background(c.primary).border(BorderStroke(1.dp, c.onSurface.copy(alpha=0.5f)), CircleShape)...) and JogginTheme.colors tokens (c.primary, c.onPrimary, c.onSurface, c.error, c.onSecondary) — NO hardcoded colours. No-active-share state: a primary pill "\uD83D\uDD17 ${S.shareLiveCreate}" plus an optional opt-in label field (reuse the existing reveal pattern) that calls controller.createShareLink(label) { result -> set a transient shareMsg }. Active-share state (controller.activeShare != null): show controller.shareUrl(token), a "Live for ..." line via S.shareLiveRemaining(formatted ShareLifetime.remainingMs(activeShare.expiresAtMs, System.currentTimeMillis()) -> e.g. \"3h 40m\"), the label if set, a Copy pill (ClipboardManager + ClipData.newPlainText, then shareMsg = S.shareLinkCopied) and a Share pill (Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND){ type=\"text/plain\"; putExtra(EXTRA_SUBJECT, S.shareLiveShareSubject); putExtra(EXTRA_TEXT, S.shareLiveShareBody(url)) } then context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(send, S.shareLiveShareSubject))), and a destructive 'Stop sharing' control styled with c.error calling controller.revokeShareLink { result -> shareMsg = ... }. Add a transient shareMsg status line mirroring codeMsg/cheerMsg. Show S.buddyUnavailableBackend when !controller.backendAvailable, matching the existing card.
acceptance_criteria: .\gradlew.bat :app:lintDebug passes with no new warnings (no hardcoded colours introduced; all new UI colours come from JogginTheme.colors tokens).
Every new AppStrings property is set in BOTH buildEnglishStrings() and buildGreekStrings() (no new UI string is a raw literal or an empty default).

The share card appears below the buddy-code card, offers create (no active) and URL + remaining-time + Copy + Share + Stop (active), and a failed revoke keeps the card showing active (activeShare cleared only on success).
verification: Run from the worktree root: .\gradlew.bat :app:testDebugUnitTest (existing suite stays green)
findings:
DONE. Verification (from worktree root, one run): .\gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin :app:assembleDebug :app:lintDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 26s. Unit tests: 144 completed, all green (existing suite + FEAT-001's Share* tests). Lint: 0 errors, 24 warnings — ALL pre-existing issue types (GradleDependency x12, IconLauncherShape x5, ScopedStorage, InlinedApi on the existing bgPermLauncher at BuddyLinkSection.kt:174, OldTargetApi, SetTextI18n, UnusedAttribute, ClickableViewAccessibility, ModifierParameter). No HardcodedText/Color lint issue and none referencing the new share code -> no new warnings, no hardcoded colours.

WHAT WAS ADDED:
- BuddyLinkController.kt: `var activeShare by mutableStateOf<ShareLink?>(restoreActiveShare()); private set` (restored from PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_TOKEN + PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_EXPIRES_AT, null when token absent OR now>=expiresAt). `createShareLink(label, onResult)` returns the existing still-valid share without minting a second (one-active-share invariant), else scope.launch creates via repo.createShareLink(label?.trim()?.take(40)), sets activeShare + calls applySharingState() on Success. `revokeShareLink(onResult)` no-ops with no token, clears activeShare ONLY on Success. `shareUrl(token)` = https://INVITE_HTTPS_HOST/s?t=token.
- Strings.kt: 13 new AppStrings props (shareLiveTitle, shareLiveCreate, shareLiveLabelHint, shareLiveRemaining:(String)->String, shareLiveStop, shareLiveCopy, shareLiveShareSubject, shareLiveShareBody:(String)->String, shareLinkCreated, shareLinkCopied, shareLinkStopped, shareLinkCreateFailed, shareLinkStopFailed) set in BOTH buildEnglishStrings() and buildGreekStrings() (formal monotonic Greek). Reused existing buddyUnavailableBackend for the backend note.
- BuddyLinkSection.kt: new private @Composable ShareLiveLocationCard(controller) rendered below the buddy-code card inside the `controller.enabled` block. No-active state: 🔗 create pill (exact CircleShape+c.primary+c.onSurface border chrome) + reveal-pattern optional label TextField. Active state: the URL, a 30s-ticking "Live for Hh Mm" line via S.shareLiveRemaining(formatShareRemaining(ShareLifetime.remainingMs(...))), Copy pill (ClipboardManager+ClipData.newPlainText) and Share pill (Intent.ACTION_SEND + createChooser), and a destructive c.error "Stop sharing" control. Transient shareMsg line mirroring codeMsg/cheerMsg; buddyUnavailableBackend shown when !backendAvailable. Added internal helper formatShareRemaining(remainingMs). JogginTheme.colors tokens only (c.primary/c.onPrimary/c.onSurface/c.error/c.onSecondary) — no hardcoded colours. AppToggle untouched.

NOTES FOR LATER STEPS: a failed revoke keeps the card showing the active share (activeShare cleared only on Success) — acceptance criterion verified in code. The card is gated by controller.enabled; it does NOT require myId. createShareLink calls applySharingState() to (re)start BuddyLocationService under CONDITION-1 reusing the existing permission path (no new permission flow). FEAT-003 still owns the Firestore rules deploy + /s hosting rewrite + reader page; this UX is inert on the NoOp build (repo returns BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE) and the backend-unavailable note shows accordingly.
